أتعاطى (form VI)
# أَتَعَاطَى (ʔataʕāṭā) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.tˤaː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# أُتَعَاطَى (ʔutaʕāṭā) /ʔu.ta.ʕaː.tˤaː/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
